**Finding: EXCLUSIVITY — compliant (preferred position).**

No exclusivity, sole-supplier or requirements obligation binds Bluefly anywhere in the Agreement. The only "exclusive" hits are tax-inclusive language (§ 4.3), IBM's exclusive-warranty disclaimer (§ 5.2), and *non*exclusive licences granted to Customer (§ 12.1, § 5.4). § 14.16 (Freedom of Action) affirmatively preserves each party's right to enter similar agreements with others, so our sourcing freedom is intact. The Customer-side restrictions that do exist — § 14.11 no resale and the § 12.1 licence-scope limits — are use/resale restrictions rather than exclusive dealing and fall outside this rule. No redline proposed.
